the separate terms of service identified in the Payment Processor List (the "Payment Processor Terms")
financial accounts and/or cryptocurrency wallets with one or more Payment Processors for Payment Processing (each a "Payment Processor Account")

bank accounts, cryptocurrency wallets, or other financial accounts designated in your Shopify Admin to receive funds from the settlement of Transactions (the "Payout Account")

(together with Card Present Transactions and all other transactions referred to in this section, "Transactions")

credit cards, debit cards and other types of cards (collectively "Cards"), cryptocurrency wallets, and other payment methods as provided under this Agreement (collectively with Cards, "Payment Methods")

translation: رصيد عمليات الدفع: الأموال التي تم تحصيلها ولكن لم تتم إضافتها بعد إلى عملية دفع مجدولة، ولا يشمل ذلك الأموال الاحتياطية.
definition: The Payout balance amount represents the funds that have been captured but not yet added to a scheduled payout, not including reserved funds.

translation: الأموال الاحتياطية: الأموال المحتجزة مؤقتاً والتي لا يمكن الوصول إليها حتى تنتهي فترة الاحتياطي.
definition: Reserved funds: Money that's temporarily held and that can't be accessed until the reserve period ends.

translation: إجمالي رصيدك هو مجموع مبالغ رصيد عمليات الدفع والأموال الاحتياطية.
definition: Your total balance is the sum of your Payout balance and Reserved funds amounts.

translation: الاحتياطي هو حجز مؤقت لجزء من مبالغ المعاملات التي تمت معالجتها عبر Shopify Payments، وفي بعض الحالات لكامل المبلغ، وذلك لفترة محددة.
definition: A reserve is a temporary hold on a portion, in some cases a full amount, of transactions processed through Shopify Payments for a specified period.
Transactions marked as Pending are for sales that you've made, but that haven't been added to a payout and sent to your bank account yet.

translation: يشير وقت التسوية إلى مقدار الوقت بين تحصيل دفعة العميل وتوفر هذه الأموال لدفعها إلى حسابك البنكي.
definition: Settlement time refers to the amount of time between when a customer's payment is captured and those funds are available to be paid out to your bank account.

translation: يحدد جدول دفعاتك موعد تحويل أموال المبيعات إلى حسابك البنكي.
definition: Your payout schedule determines when funds from sales are transferred to your bank account.

Acquirer — means a financial institution that is registered with the applicable Payment Networks to acquire payment card transactions and that sponsors a Shopify entity's registration as a Payment Facilitator (or equivalent designation) with those Payment Networks.

Payment Facilitator — an entity registered with the Payment Networks under an Acquirer's sponsorship and in accordance with the Payment Network Rules that contracts with Merchants to facilitate the Merchant's acceptance of payment transactions.
Settlement of your valid Transactions, net of fees, refunds, chargebacks, reserves, and other amounts owed, will be paid to your Payout Account.

Financial account information for merchants using Shopify Payments. Tracks current balances across all supported currencies, payout schedules, and [`ShopifyPaymentsBalanceTransaction`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/objects/ShopifyPaymentsBalanceTransaction) records.
A transfer of funds between a merchant's Shopify Payments balance and their [`ShopifyPaymentsBankAccount`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/objects/ShopifyPaymentsBankAccount).

translation: يمكن لأنواع الحسابات التالية قبول عمليات الدفع عبر Shopify Payments:
يحدد توقيت عوائد Shopify Payments متى تتوفر الأموال من مبيعاتك في حسابك البنكي.
definition: Shopify Payments payout timing determines when funds from your sales are available in your bank account.

translation: بعد معالجة الدفع، يتم تحويل مبلغ الشراء إلى حساب التاجر الخاص بك.

term: Settlement (Adyen for Platforms Terms and Conditions)
definition: The transmission of funds by Processor to User that Processor has received from Acquirers, Scheme Owners, and/or Issuers, as applicable, in connection with Transactions minus any amounts payable to Processor or paid by Processor on behalf of User, and (if applicable) any amounts needed to keep the Rolling Reserve at the then current Reserve Level.

term: Rolling Reserve(s) (Adyen for Platforms Terms and Conditions)
definition: A sum of money withheld from Settlement by Processor as security for Chargebacks, Fines and other potential fees due to Processor.

“Reserve” means collateral funds which Stripe holds and controls to satisfy any liabilities or potential liabilities User incurs under this Agreement, including any funds described as “Reserve” amounts in the Reserve Notice, the Stripe Dashboard or in any other communications to User.

translation: يؤدي تحصيل الدفع إلى إرسال تفاصيل المعاملة إلى المُستحوِذ، وهو بنك أو مؤسسة مالية تعالج معاملات بطاقات الائتمان نيابةً عن عملك.
definition: Capturing a payment sends the transaction details to the acquirer, which is a bank or financial institution that processes credit card transactions on behalf of your business.

translation: بعد أن يدفع العميل لطلب باستخدام Shopify Payments وعمليات إتمام الدفع السريع المحددة، يتم تحويل الأموال إلى الحساب البنكي لعمليات الدفع الذي أعددته مع Shopify Payments.

definition: A merchant of record is the legal entity responsible for selling products to a customer, and for adhering to local laws and regulations in another region or country.
This is because Stripe is Shopify Payments' banking partner, and all payment reporting and management takes place in your Shopify admin.

term: Stripe Account; Stripe Account balance (Stripe agreements)
definition: “Stripe Account” means a Stripe account through which User accesses the Services.
